info.name: COMP3123 Assignment 1
info.description:
Secure Employee REST API - Postman tests for every required endpoint.

HOW TO RUN
1. Start MongoDB and the server (npm start). Default baseUrl is http://localhost:3000.
2. Use an EMPTY users and employees collection (drop them in Compass), because signup expects alice_01 and bob_02 to be new.
3. Restart the server so the rate-limit counters are empty.
4. Run the collection with the Collection Runner, folders in order. Folder 07 must stay last.
5. To run the expired-token check, set the collection variable jwtSecret to your JWT_SECRET (Current value only, and clear it before exporting).

To re-run: drop users + employees, restart the server, run again.

item.name: 01 Health
item.description: Server is up, Helmet headers present, unknown routes and bad JSON return JSON errors.

request.description: Expect 200 with status ok and database connected. Check the Headers tab for Helmet.

exec: pm.test("Helmet headers present, X-Powered-By removed", function () { pm.expect(pm.response.headers.has("X-Content-Type-Options")).to.eql(true); pm.expect(pm.response.headers.has("X-Frame-Options")).to.eql(true); pm.expect(pm.response.headers.has("Strict-Transport-Security")).to.eql(true); pm.expect(pm.response.headers.has("Content-Security-Policy")).to.eql(true); pm.expect(pm.response.headers.has("X-Powered-By")).to.eql(false); });

pm.test("Standard error body (status:false, error:true, code:404)", function () { var j = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(j.status).to.eql(false); pm.expect(j.error).to.eql(true); pm.expect(j.code).to.eql(404); });

item.name: 03 Login
item.description: Login by username and by email, bad credentials, missing fields and an injection attempt. Saves tokenA and tokenB.

exec: pm.test("Says username or email is required", function () { pm.expect(JSON.stringify(pm.response.json().errors)).to.include("username or email is required"); });
pm.test("errors list names 'username'", function () { var e = pm.response.json().errors || []; pm.expect(e.map(function (x) { return x.field; })).to.include("username"); });

item.name: 04 JWT
item.description: Missing, invalid, expired and valid tokens against a protected endpoint.

exec: pm.test("Message is 'No token provided'", function () { pm.expect(pm.response.json().message).to.eql("No token provided"); });

pm.test("Standard error body (status:false, error:true, code:401)", function () { var j = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(j.status).to.eql(false); pm.expect(j.error).to.eql(true); pm.expect(j.code).to.eql(401); });

item.name: 05 Employee CRUD
item.description: All CRUD operations and validation errors as Alice.

exec: pm.test("Employee created and owned by Alice", function () { var j = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(j.first_name).to.eql("Ada"); pm.expect(j.salary).to.be.a("number"); pm.expect(j.user).to.eql(pm.collectionVariables.get("userIdA")); });

item.name: 06 Two-user ownership
item.description: User A and User B each own an employee. Cross-user GET, PUT and DELETE must return 403 both ways.

exec: pm.test("Every employee belongs to Alice and Bob's is absent", function () { var list = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(list.length).to.be.above(0); list.forEach(function (e) { pm.expect(e.user).to.eql(pm.collectionVariables.get("userIdA")); }); pm.expect(list.map(function (e) { return e._id; })).to.not.include(pm.collectionVariables.get("empIdB")); });

pm.test("Every employee belongs to Bob and Alice's is absent", function () { var list = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(list.length).to.be.above(0); list.forEach(function (e) { pm.expect(e.user).to.eql(pm.collectionVariables.get("userIdB")); }); pm.expect(list.map(function (e) { return e._id; })).to.not.include(pm.collectionVariables.get("empIdA")); });

item.name: 07 Rate limit
item.description: Run LAST. Bad logins repeat until 429. After this, restart the server to reset the counters.

request.description: In the Collection Runner this repeats automatically until it gets a 429. Sending it by hand: click Send until the status changes from 401 to 429.

exec: // keep sending bad logins until the limiter blocks us (Collection Runner only)
pm.test("Limiter returned 429 after " + count + " bad logins", function () { pm.response.to.have.status(429); });
pm.test("429 uses the standard error body", function () { var j = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(j.code).to.eql(429); pm.expect(j.message).to.eql("Too many requests. Please try again later."); });
